summary: Native Android release 0.5.15 (versionCode 17): attached photos are scaled and re-encoded on the phone to fit the 3 MiB message limit (phone-image-resize.json); Switchboard's stored system rows render instead of an 'Unsupported event' card, and AskUserQuestion options keep a readable label beside a long description (phone-system-markers.json, question-option-layout.json).

desktop.reason: Android version bump only; the desktop parts are covered by phone-image-resize.json and phone-system-markers.json.

reactNativeIos.reason: The Expo client has its own lane; this bump touches only apps/android.

sharedBackendApi.reason: No API or wire change: Send on a Not delivered row calls the existing provider:deliver-peer-message channel.

automated: mobile-release.yml runs the Android unit and lint gate and verifies package, signer fingerprint and checksum, and a version higher than the newest published APK when one exists (the monotonic check is skipped when no earlier APK asset is found), before it publishes.
notExercised: Installing the update on a physical device through the in-app updater.
The verification API accepting the APK; that runs after the release publishes.
